meta.name: swiftui-liquid-glass
meta.description: Implement, review, or improve SwiftUI features using the iOS 26+ Liquid Glass API. Use when asked to adopt Liquid Glass in new SwiftUI UI, refactor an existing feature to Liquid Glass, or review Liquid Glass usage for correctness, performance, and design alignment.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用 iOS 26+ Liquid Glass API 实现或改进 SwiftUI 界面
copy.tagline_en: Implement or improve SwiftUI UI using iOS 26+ Liquid Glass API
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are building SwiftUI apps for iOS 26+ and want to adopt Liquid Glass design.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你用 iOS 26+ 的 Liquid Glass API 实现、审查或改进 SwiftUI 界面，生成带玻璃效果的代码。
howto.when: 当你要求为 SwiftUI 界面添加 Liquid Glass 效果、重构现有功能以使用 Liquid Glass，或审查 Liquid Glass 用法时触发。

say.text: 帮我给这个卡片加上 Liquid Glass 效果。
say.note: Claude 会添加 glassEffect 修饰符。

say.text: 审查这段 SwiftUI 代码的 Liquid Glass 使用是否正确。
say.note: Claude 会检查可用性、修饰符顺序等。

say.text: 用 GlassEffectContainer 重构这个视图。
say.note: Claude 会将多个玻璃元素包裹在容器中。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can implement, review, or improve SwiftUI features using the iOS 26+ Liquid Glass API, generating code with glass effects.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to adopt Liquid Glass in new SwiftUI UI, refactor an existing feature to Liquid Glass, or review Liquid Glass usage.

say_en.text: Add Liquid Glass effect to this card.
Review this SwiftUI code for Liquid Glass correctness.
say_en.note: Claude checks availability, modifier order, etc.
Claude wraps multiple glass elements in a container.
